##### Project general facts

Amal Tower is a luxury Dubai condominium featuring an exceptional collection of residences tailored for comfortable and luxurious living. This transcendent development offers impressive spaces for indoor and outdoor amenities, creating a lifestyle of unparalleled sophistication. Inspired by the warm climate, golden light, and the unique soul of Dubai, the tower seamlessly intertwines indoor and outdoor living areas, with views pouring in through oversized floor-to-ceiling windows that celebrate the surrounding landscape.

Amal Tower features a premium collection of amenities designed to enhance every aspect of daily life. Residents enjoy a rooftop infinity pool, jacuzzi, and sauna for ultimate relaxation, a rooftop fitness studio for wellness, a business center for productivity, and a kid's play area for families. Six elevators accommodate a grand entry lobby, setting a refined tone from the moment residents and guests arrive.

Every residence at Amal Tower is meticulously decorated with upscale finishes, fitted with the most premium materials including lustrous marbles, natural stones, Italian fabrics, and delicate details that come together to enhance the living experience. Fully furnished interiors and equipped kitchens ensure every home is a sanctuary of elegance and comfort, where every inch reflects a commitment to quality and sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Sports City, a vibrant and dynamic community that embodies the spirit of sports, leisure, and active living, this exceptional location is meticulously planned to cater to the needs of athletes, sports enthusiasts, and those seeking a balanced and energetic lifestyle. The community is home to world-class sporting facilities, including the Dubai International Stadium and the Els Club golf course, providing residents with opportunities to engage in various sports and recreational activities.

The location is distinguished by its central position, ensuring easy access to Dubai's major attractions, business districts, and educational institutions. The community hosts numerous entertainment venues, dining options, and shopping destinations, offering a well-rounded and dynamic lifestyle that fosters a sense of community and promotes well-being.

For those seeking a residence that embodies luxury, active living, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Sports City delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class sporting facilities, strategic connectivity, and vibrant community makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one's passion for an active and fulfilling lifestyle can flourish.
